verdict.rationale: Graphite serves Markdown versions of its docs (get-started.md returns HTTP 200), and those pages point agents to a full documentation index on a Mintlify-hosted llms endpoint, so agent-oriented docs exist. However, the conventional https://graphite.com/llms.txt returns 404, so an agent pointed at the standard location fails, and the index lives on a third-party subdomain. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the canonical domain root, verification that the Mintlify llms index resolves and is complete, any first-party docs describing agent-oriented documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
